question: Maternity Leave is admissible for a period not exceeding _______ in the entire service in the case of abortion.
Advance credit of Earnd Leave on 1st January and 1st July each year willbe reduced by _______ of the period of Extraordinary Leave availed by Government Servant during the preceding half year.
Half Pay Leave upto a maximum of _______ may be allowed to be commuted without production of Medical Certificate during the entire service.
Leave not due may be granted on Medical Certificate upto a maximum of _______ during the entire service.
Commuted leave upto a maximum of _______ can be granted in continuation of Maternity Leave without production of Medical Certificate.
Government servant when resigned from service will be granted cash equivalent to the extent of half of Earned Leave at his credit.
Earning of Half Pay Leave is not affected by spells of Extraordinary Leave.
Unmaried Female Government Servant is not eligible for the grant of Maternity Leave
It is not permissible to take up private employment during Leave preparatory to retirement.
Leave salary in respect of Commuted Leave will be equal to those admissible while proceeding on Half Pay Leave.
The LTC can be availed during any kind of Leave including leave on Medical Certificate, Casual Leave/Special Casual Leave.
LTC for the two years block of 1990-91 can be carried over to 1992. However it will lapse if it is not availed on or before the end of December 1992.
Family includes major sons, married daughters, widowed daughters so long as they are residing with and wholly dependent upon the Government servant for the purpose of LTC.
A Government Servant under suspension also can avail LTC either to visit any place in India or to visit his Home Town but not his family members.
LTC claims is required to be submitted within one month after the completion of the return journey.
Claim for TA for medical treatment limited to actual Bus/rail fare only and D.A. is not admissible.
Cost of heart pace maker and replacement of pulse generator are reimburseable.
Sales tax when charged in the bill for the purchase of medicines are not reimburseable.
For the purpose of Medical Attendance Rules, family of a Government servant includes sisters including widowed sisters.
Fees paid for eyes testing for glasses once in every three years including cost of spectacles are reimbursemburseable.
